datasets.name: ods_cust
datasets.sql:
SELECT (select kod_filial from filial_t where id=o.filialid)as BANK_BRANCH_CODE,p.id as CLIENT_NO,p.cust_type as CLIENT_TYPE,
decode(p.nerezident,0,'RES',1,'GRES')as CLIENT_NATIONALTY,'' CLIENT_SYMBOL_NO, p.firstname as CLIENT_NAME,p.lastname as CLIENT_SURNAME,  p.patronymic as CLIENT_FATHERS_NAME,
to_char(p.birthdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') as CLIENT_DATE_BIRTH,p.birthplace||'/'||p.BIRTH_STATE as CLIENT_PLACE_OF_BIRTH,p.DOC_TYPE as CLIENT_ID_TYPE,'' CLIENT_ID_COMMENT,
p.passport as CLIENT_ID_SERIAL,p.passp_number as CLIENT_ID_NUMBER,
p.passpin as  CLIENT_ID_PIN,to_char(p.paspdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') as CLIENT_ID_ISSUE_DATE,
(select cntr_name ||'/'||p.paspplace from countries where id= p.doc_country)as CLIENT_ID_ISSUE_PLACE,p.adress as CLIENT_ID_ADDRESS,p.fakt_adress as CLIENT_ID_ADDRESS_REAL,
p.email as CLIENT_ID_EMAIL,p.phone_mob as CLIENT_ID_PHONE_MOBILE ,p.phone as CLIENT_ID_PHONE_HOME,p.work_phone as CLIENT_ID_PHONE

from PCust_view p ,sba_objinf o where   p.cust_type<>0 and p.close_dat is  null and p.op_id=o.sysuserid(+)

--and p.id in(1,169,205)
order by :title

datasets.name: Ods_cust_person_work
datasets.sql:
select r.*,w.*,p.name as prinad_name  from customers_relations r,work_posts w ,prinad p where r.work_post=w.id and w.type=1 and r.prinad=p.id(+)
 and custid=:V_CUSTID

datasets.name: KreditDSet
datasets.sql:
select 
p.boorowerid CLIENT_NO,
f.kod_filial KRD_BRANCH_CODE,
p.numberofcredit KREDIT_ID_NUMBER,
cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.loanaccid) KREDIT_ACCOUNT_IBAN_NUMBER,
v.val_name KREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE,
p.creditlineamount KREDIT_CURRENCY_AMOUNT,
p.creditlineamount*k.ostat KREDIT_AZN_AMOUNT,
h.interestrest KREDIT_INTEREST_AMOUNT,
to_char(p.dateofconclusion,'yyyy-mm-dd') KREDIT_VALUE_DATE,
to_char(p.duedatefirstcontract,'yyyy-mm-dd') KREDIT_MATURITY_DATE ,
p.annualyinterestrate KREDIT_PERCENT,
cm_common.get_AccountBalance(a.loanaccid) KREDIT_BALANCE_ACCOUNT,
'NONE' KREDIT_SOURCE,'' COLLETRAL_INFO,'' COLLETRAL_BRANCH_CODE,'' COLLETRAL_CLIENT_NO,'' COLLETRAL_ACCOUNT_IBAN_NUMBER
 from cm_active_credits p,filial_t f,cm_accounts a,avalute_t v,temprate k,cm_curr_state h
 where
 p.id=a.creditid and 
 p.id=h.creditid and 
 p.branchid=f.id and --p.boorowerid =203 and
 p.currency=v.valute and 
 v.valute=k.val_kod

datasets.name: Ods_cust_person_joint
datasets.sql:
SELECT 
p.id, p.firstname ,p.lastname ,  p.patronymic,to_char(p.birthdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') as CLIENT_DATE_BIRTH,p.birthplace||'/'||p.BIRTH_STATE as PLACE_OF_BIRTH,p.DOC_TYPE ,
p.passport ,p.passp_number,p.passpin ,to_char(p.paspdate ,'YYYY-MM-DD')as paspdate,(select cntr_name ||'/'||p.paspplace from countries where id= p.doc_country)as ISSUE_PLACE,p.adress
 ,p.fakt_adress ,p.email ,p.phone_mob  ,p.phone ,p.inn,p.info_tph_adress ,p.cust_type,'' CLIENT_SYMBOL_NO ,'' CLIENT_ID_COMMENT,p.work_phone
from PCust_view p where   p.cust_type<>0 and p.close_dat is  null 
 and p.id=:v_id

datasets.name: Ods_cust_joint_work
datasets.sql:
select*from customers_relations r,work_posts w where r.work_post=w.id and w.type=2 and custid=:V_CUSTID

order by custid2

datasets.name: ods_account
datasets.sql:
select
 a.id,
 (select balname from bal_spr1 where bal_cn=a.bal_cn1)as name,
  a.bal_cn1,
 (select kod_filial from filial_t where id=a.filial)as fil_kod,
 (select name from filial_t where id=a.filial)as fil_name,
(select val_name from avalute_t where valute=a.val_acc)as val_kod,
 abs(cm_common.accountrest_get(a.id))as ostat,
(select round(ostat*abs(cm_common.accountrest_get(a.id)),2) from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=a.val_acc)as pok_ostat,
(select abs(sum(obr_d))from archost where acc_id=a.id and datdate between :d1 and :d2)as debt_dov,
(select abs(sum(obr_k))from archost where acc_id=a.id and datdate between :d1 and :d2)as kredit_dov

from account a where close_dat is null and a.id in(435318,413287,25270,25271,25280,25281)
order by a.id
